المنفذ لم يرجع رد TLS صالحًا. غالبًا الر: This port did not return a valid TLS response. The URL may be using HTTPS on an HTTP port. Use the protocol and port supplied by your provider. Change to HTTP only if that is the correct service URL.

السيرفر حدّد عدد الطلبات أو الاتصالات. أ: The server has limited requests or connections. Stop playback on other devices and try again.
رد HTTP 488 غير قياسي؛ قد يصدر من البواب: HTTP 488 is a nonstandard response from the portal or an intermediary. Check the MAC portal URL and activation with your provider. This code alone does not identify the cause.
HTTP 511 normally requests network access authentication. A network gateway or intermediary may be responding, or the provider may use the code differently. Try another network, then check the stream URL and activation with your provider.
A server or intermediary returned an error while processing the request.
The receiving endpoint returned an HTTP error.
